summary: Comprehensive testing of ProDelivery Bacău MVP - Romanian ride-sharing/delivery platform. All 5 WOW features implemented and working: 1) Bacău-centric map with real restaurant names, 2) Simulated driver movement on map, 3) Admin dashboard graphs (recharts), 4) Sound notifications + driver notification for new orders, 5) Custom branding 'PRODELIVERY BACAU'. All 3 roles tested (Admin, Driver, Restaurant).

ui_bugs.issue: Modal overlay intercepts click events - requires force=True in Playwright. Works fine for manual testing.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor ESLint warning in DriverApp.jsx line 165 - useCallback missing lastOrderId dependency (can be ignored or added to dep array)

login_page.details: PRODELIVERY BACAU branding, Demo Admin/Driver/Restaurant buttons, credentials shown

admin_dashboard.details: Shows 5 Bacău restaurants (Trattoria Da Vinci, La Cuptor Bacău, Sushi Room, Burger Craft, Casa Moldoveanu)

admin_analytics.details: Two charts: 'Comenzi pe Oră' bar chart, 'Venituri pe Oră' area chart, plus 'Sumar Zi Curentă' stats

admin_map.details: Map centered on Bacău (46.567, 26.913), 10 markers (5 drivers + 5 restaurants), LIVE badge, legend for Livrator Activ/Inactiv/Restaurant

admin_order_assignment.details: Can assign orders to drivers via dialog with driver selector

driver_app.details: Check-in feature for scheduling hours (10:00-02:00), NICIO COMANDĂ state, Accept/Pickup/Deliver buttons

restaurant_app.details: Orders list with preparation time buttons (5-30 min), COMANDA GATA button, stats for Noi/În Pregătire/Livrate

api_seed.details: Creates 100 orders, 5 drivers, 5 restaurants - all with Bacău addresses (not București)

api_stats_hourly.details: Returns hourly_orders and hourly_revenue arrays for charts

bacau_addresses.details: All 100 orders have Bacău street addresses, 0 have București

mocked_apis.hourly_stats: Simulated data using today's date as random seed - consistent per day
mocked_apis.driver_movement: Frontend-only simulation - positions change every 3s for active drivers
mocked_apis.settings_zones: UI-only demo - settings not persisted to backend

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed creates full demo data - 100 orders with Bacău addresses
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional MVP. All features working. Database seeded with POST /api/seed. Three roles: admin (/admin), driver (/driver), restaurant (/restaurant). Charts use recharts library. Map uses Leaflet centered on Bacău coordinates. Driver movement is frontend simulation only.
